{{Quote|Darmin will be travelling in a YT-1300 named the 'Nerfs Pride', and will likely have an armed escort.''"<br />"'''Nerfs Pride'?''"<br />"''Apparently he was some sort of nerf herder on his native Alderaan. The ships name is not of concern.|[[Prisk Kith'Vys]] and an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:ETRDDM" />}}
The '''''Nerfs Pride''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] owned by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Darmin Lerspri]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ETRDDM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Lerspri undertook a mission to the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in order to convince the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] government to support the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the war against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, the ''Nerfs Pride'' was attacked in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] by Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] led by [[Prisk Kith'Vys]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] special unit [[Black Epsilon]] destroyed the ship and its escort, thereby killing the diplomat before he could land on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:ETRDDM" />
